notes.title: Small bug fix update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've update the game to fix some bugs:
- Menu being not responsive on 30.000 Hz refresh rate
- Volume knobs sometimes being not draggable when they are at min/max values

notes.title: A Way Back is OUT!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569170

[previewyoutube=UG3dxxw4asY;full][/previewyoutube]

We are so glad to announce that A Way Back is OUT!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263347/cb8dedcf366551099b7b96b911a55fcc940101ce.gif[/img]

And as we promised, half of the proceeds during the 1st 7 days after the launch will be donated to Ukraine!

notes.title: A Way Back is coming out soon and we stand with Ukraine!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569170

[previewyoutube=877OBgN2Yng;full][/previewyoutube]

After a year of hard work we are finally ready to release A Way Back into the world! 
We hope you'll enjoy the puzzles and will help the little penguin cleaning the islands from plastic. Go forth penguin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263347/cb8dedcf366551099b7b96b911a55fcc940101ce.gif[/img]

With that we would like to also announce that as a team of Ukrainians we stand with Ukraine and half our proceeds during the first 7 days after the launch will be donated to Ukraine!
